card.name: Words inside ALL-CAPS warning text
card.fires_on: Words and punctuation inside all-capitals warning passages, such as boxed warnings and hypersensitivity alerts. It also fires on the commas and small linking words (BY, IF, SHOULD) in those passages.

modes.label: Commas and linkers in capitals
modes.description: A comma or small linking word within an all-caps warning sentence.
modes.example: INTRAVENOUS STEROIDS AND AIRWAY MANAGEMENT, INCLUDING INTUBATION<<,>> SHOULD ALSO BE ADMINISTERED AS IND

modes.label: Partway through capitalised words
modes.description: The ending of a long capitalised or title-like word, as in a URL or headline.
modes.example: INK REMOTE SENS<<ING>> ACCORD* The Earth Observation Satellite Co
